description: This file contains automated test cases for the LocationDao class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It tests various methods such as retrieving location details, counting employees at a location, and searching locations using different filters.

classes.name: LocationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LocationDao data access object in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes tests for methods like getLocationById, searchLocations, getLocationsIdList, and others.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an instance of LocationDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetLocationById
methods.description: Verifies that getLocationById returns the correct Location object for a valid ID.

methods.name: testGetLocationByIdForNonExistingId
methods.description: Verifies that getLocationById returns null when given a non-existent ID.

methods.name: testGetNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Checks if getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation returns the correct count for a given location ID.

methods.name: testGetLocationList
methods.description: Ensures getLocationsIdList returns the correct number of location IDs.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForNullArray
methods.description: Tests searchLocations with default filter parameters, expecting all locations.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForLocationName
methods.description: Verifies searchLocations filters locations by name correctly.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForCity
methods.description: Verifies searchLocations filters locations by city.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForCountry
methods.description: Checks if searchLocations filters correctly by country code.

methods.name: testGetSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Verifies that getSearchLocationListCount correctly counts locations matching search filters.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Tests getLocationIdsForEmployees returns the correct location IDs for a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesOneEmployee
methods.description: Checks behavior with a single employee number.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesNoEmployees
methods.description: Checks behavior when no employee numbers are provided.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesEmployeesWithoutLocations
methods.description: Tests handling of employees that are not assigned to any location.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesInvalidEmployees
methods.description: Verifies behavior with employee IDs that do not exist.

methods.name: testGetLocationsByIds
methods.description: Verifies that getLocationsByIds returns the correct number of Location objects when given a list of IDs.
